# Workflows and notifications

Trigger Apify Actors from workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make, and Zapier), embed them as nodes in no-code agent builders, and route results into chat, email, and other team tools.

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/n8n.md

[Open-source workflow automation. Run Apify Actors and route their data through n8n's node graph.](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/n8n.md)
